plainText:
Harrison's Sneasel (Japanese: ハヅキのニューラ Hazuki's Nyula) is the only was seen to capture.

==History==
 
Sneasel first appeared in Pop Goes The Sneasel. It was a wild Pokémon working alongside a and that were blocking people from accessing 's flame kept in the Ho-Oh Shrine on Mt. Silver. It threatened , attacking with and defeating in a single hit. It then ordered its cronies to send Team Rocket blasting off. It later attacked as he reached the temple, and fought his , interrupting his dance with a pair of attacks. It dodged Totodile's , and used , followed by a , to knock him out.
 
Team Rocket made a failed attempt to capture Sneasel, but Meowth's bitterness at being replaced as the trio's mascot caused the plan to fall apart and they defeated themselves. then ordered his into . Sneasel proved no match for Blaziken's sheer power and type advantage, being knocked out with a to the face. Harrison threw a and Sneasel.

Despite being new to his team, Harrison trusted its strength enough to use it in the Silver Conference, where it faced a and defeated it, despite the significant type disadvantage. 

In Playing with Fire!, it fought against Ash's Pikachu as Harrison's second Pokémon. It easily used its speed to dodge and took Pikachu out with . It then fought a rematch with Totodile, who learned from Pikachu's mistake and instead down on Metal Claw. He then danced around while thrashing Sneasel against the ground. A powerful blow from Totodile's tail eliminated Sneasel, causing Totodile to dance in celebration.
 

==Personality and characteristics==
Sneasel first appeared to be a very mischievous, stubborn, and strong Pokémon, as it prevented people from accessing 's flame, despite the fact that the entire Silver Conference would stand still without the flame. Nevertheless, it lost its attitude upon capture and turned out to be a very reliable and trustworthy Pokémon, to the effect that Harrison chose it to battle in the Silver Conference.
